Your idea's still in your head… and that's exactly why it's worth nothing.I've watched thousands of would-be builders, and the #1 thing keeping them stuck isn't talent or time. It's that they never ship.They usually fall into one of two camps:They've got a "someday" idea they keep researching, tweaking, and talking about, but never build.They've got a half-built project rotting in a folder because they scoped it way too big to ever finish.Either way, real people have never touched it.All you need to change that is one small thing, live, that someone can actually use this weekend. That's what we build in ship·able.

Everything you need to know, in ten seconds.It's $9. One-time. Less than your weekend coffee run, and you walk out with a live MVP.It's a 90-minute live workshop on Zoom when the next date opens. Can't make it live? You get the full replay.It's for anyone with an idea they haven't shipped. Non-technical totally welcome. We build with AI tools, no code required.You walk out with a live, shareable URL plus a locked 48-hour build plan you can finish this weekend.It works for any idea: SaaS, a tool, a marketplace, a side project. We've broken down 78 of them.Live attendees get 2 bonuses: the AI MVP Builder + the Weekend MVP Starter Kit. Combined value $348.

Three moves. Shipped on the call.01Your sharpest ideaOne buyer, one painful problem. We cut your idea down from "cool concept" to the one specific thing one specific person will use on day one.~25 min02Your weekend cutThe smallest version you can actually ship by Sunday. Not the dream app. The one screen that proves it. We scope it so it fits in a weekend, not a quarter.~30 min03Your live launch pageBuilt live with AI: a deployed page with a real URL and a way to capture your first users, so you're validating demand before you sink a weekend into building.~35 min
